candidate_relations.scope_detail: COVID rhinosinusitis vs IgG4 plus S. constellatus

candidate_relations.reason: Invasive fungal sinusitis is a differential for bony orbital-apex erosion, not the IgG4 plus bacterial composite.
Post-COVID-19 rhinosinusitis omits IgG4 disease and culture-proven S. constellatus.
Granulomatosis with polyangiitis is a vasculitis differential for erosive sinus disease, not the reference composite.
IgG4-related disease is the parent systemic diagnosis and omits rhinosinusitis plus S. constellatus.
Sarcoidosis is a different granulomatous disease from the IgG4-bacterial rhinosinusitis composite.
Sinonasal lymphoma is a different infiltrative mass diagnosis.
Mucormycosis is a different invasive fungal sinusitis from the reference composite.
Acute invasive fungal sinusitis is a considered aggressive-sinus differential, not IgG4 plus bacterial disease.
Eosinophilic granulomatosis with polyangiitis is a different vasculitis from the reference diagnosis.
IgG4-related systemic disease omits concurrent Streptococcus constellatus rhinosinusitis.
Invasive bacterial rhinosinusitis with orbital apex syndrome captures S. constellatus invasion but omits IgG4-related rhinosinusitis.
Sphenoethmoidal sinus cancer is a different neoplastic diagnosis.
Tolosa–Hunt syndrome is a painful orbital-apex differential, not the IgG4-bacterial composite.
Sinusitis-induced orbital abscess is a possible orbital complication, not the full reference diagnosis.
Ethmoid sinusitis is only one anatomic component of the pansinus process and omits IgG4 plus S. constellatus.
IgG4-related disease with orbital/sinus involvement omits concurrent Streptococcus constellatus infection.
Aspergillosis is a different fungal sinusitis from the reference composite.
IgG4-related ophthalmic disease captures orbital involvement but omits bacterial rhinosinusitis.
COVID-19-associated mucormycosis is a different post-COVID invasive fungus.
